title: Covered and Excluded Components under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons
content:
Each rider of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons lists the components it covers and the components and losses it never covers. Two riders carry an additional coverage feature: the Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider covers separate spa equipment, and the Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider covers guest unit kitchen appliances to the base tier's appliance coverage.

## Components by rider

| Rider | Covered components | Never covered |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider | compressor; sealed system; evaporator fan; defrost system; thermostat | ice maker; water dispenser; shelves and bins; food spoilage |
| Bridgewell Septic System Rider | septic pump; aerobic pump; septic tank line from the house | drain field; leach lines; septic tank replacement; lift station alarm wiring |
| Bridgewell Well Pump Rider | well pump; pressure tank; pressure switch; well pump wiring | well casing; well drilling or redrilling; storage tanks other than the pressure tank |
| Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider | roof leak repair over an occupied area | flat roof; patio covers and gutters; skylights; interior water damage; full roof replacement |
| Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider | pool pump; pool motor; pool filter; pool heater; timer; above-ground plumbing | pool lining and structure; salt chlorinator; solar pool heating; cleaning equipment; spa equipment |
| Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider | pool pump; pool motor; pool filter; pool heater; timer; above-ground plumbing; spa pump; spa heater; spa blower | pool lining and structure; salt chlorinator; solar pool heating; cleaning equipment; spa shell and covers |
| Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider | guest unit systems, as the base tier covers them; guest unit kitchen appliances, as the base tier covers them | a guest unit over the size limit; items the base tier does not cover |

## Additional coverage features

| Rider | Separate spa equipment covered | Guest unit kitchen appliances covered to the base tier's appliance coverage |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider | No | No |
| Bridgewell Septic System Rider | No | No |
| Bridgewell Well Pump Rider | No | No |
| Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider | No | No |
| Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider | No | No |
| Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider | Yes | No |
| Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider | No | Yes |

## Points of reference

**Is a spa heater covered under the Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider?** No. That rider lists spa equipment among the items it never covers; the spa pump, spa heater and spa blower are covered components of the Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider.

**Is the ice maker of a second refrigerator covered?** No. The Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider lists the ice maker among the items it never covers.

**Does the Bridgewell Septic System Rider cover a drain field?** No. The drain field and the leach lines are listed among the items it never covers.
